name: Zum brennenden Bären
notes: Burning Bär is taking a pause in 2019 to look for a new site. ZbB 2019 was thus created by some of the old core team and newcomers as "a more-radical, co-creative concept with the old burner spirit" in the same 19th century castle where Burning Bär used to take place.

name: AlmaBurn
notes: Alma Burn is located on the Guadalupe River in Central Texas

name: Figment Alpha
notes: Every participant has to bring or work on an interactive or participatory art project. ALPHA was launched by FIGMENT in 2013; first edition April 26-28, 2013 at Camp Ramblewood.

name: Catharsis on the Mall
notes: A 48-hour vigil held on the National Mall, in the shadow of the Washington Monument, that features lectures, discussions, workshops, music, community art and a temple burn

name: Ignite!
notes: Focus on "Learn'n'burn" through playforms, i.e. platforms for playful learning

name: Freezer Burn
notes: Held near the equinox so the days can be up to 18 hours long

name: Montopia
notes: Formerly known as Montana Burning Bear. New site in the same area.

name: SunBurn
notes: Formerly Enchantment Burn in Arizona, held in new Mexico since 2016.

name: POrtalBurn
notes: Has lots of whips and the world's largest ice cream cones in the local town. New site.

name: Home Burn
notes: The Morris Burner Hostel's parallel burn
